confirmedFix.rootCause: The exporter replaces a terminal-adjacent grid point even when it is a via landing. For a same-cell inter-layer route, both landing points disappear while the via stays at the grid center.
confirmedFix.change: Keep only the grid points that would otherwise move a via; attach the requested terminal coordinates as stubs. Same treatment already exists in A03.
confirmedFix.syntheticBefore: Solver reports solved but exported route contains no landing on either via layer.
confirmedFix.syntheticAfter: Both via layers are represented at the exact via coordinate; both terminals retain their requested positions.
confirmedFix.selectionReason: A small, unambiguous correctness defect that can reject otherwise solved candidates. Repairing exported geometry avoids introducing another routing strategy or changing budgets.
